threads.body:
`message.getMessageId()` is called twice in the same ternary expression. If the underlying `Message` can return a non-null id and then `null` (which seems plausible given the motivation for this PR), this can NPE on the second call when `.toString()` is invoked. Consider reading `message.getMessageId()` into a local variable once and converting that single value to String.

This issue also appears on line 49 of the same file.
